_doc: How tools/audio.py drives the sound engine. RAM names come from ram.inc. The game requests music with wMusicTrackToPlay and sound effects through hJingle / hWaveSfx / hNoiseSfx, which UpdateVolumeAndSfxRequests (bank $1F) copies into wJingleToPlay / wWaveSfxToPlay / wNoiseSfxToPlay once a frame; here the requests go straight into those bytes. UpdateSound runs once a frame: the effect engine of bank $1F, then the music engines of banks $1B (tracks $01-$10, $31-$40) and $1E (tracks $11-$30, $41-$60). Both music banks share the channel records wMusicChannel1-4 at $D310.

music.label: Music
music._playing: the song number inside its bank's table; 0 when a song without a loop ends

loop_channels._doc: a channel has looped when its record repeats an earlier state at a note: pattern list pointer (+0), pattern pointer (+4), the $9B repeat's start (+C) and count (+F); a repeat inside a pattern ($9B..$9C) never matches, because its count differs. Channels without a pattern list (+1 = 0) are unused, and so are channels that only rest (MusicSilentChannel_1B/1E: 32 of the longest rests, again and again)

music_channels._doc: per channel: its RAM record, the offset of the pattern pointer (the note just played is the byte before it), the pattern list pointer, and the flag byte/bit set while a sound effect owns the channel

pokes._doc: the item fanfares $0F, $10 and $25 start hLastMusicTrack again when they end; $FF stops the music instead

jingle 1: someone hands over or takes a trade item (the witch, Tarin, Kiki, Grandma Ulrira)
jingle 2: a puzzle is solved or a secret appears (room events, Kiki's bridge, the mermaid statue, the signpost maze)
jingle 4: the sword is fully charged for a spin attack
jingle 6: the genie leaves its bottle, the Mad Batter appears
jingle 7: the sword, the shovel or the boomerang hits something hard
jingle 8: something is grabbed or thrown (Mad Bomber, Monkey, Smasher, Hinox, the walrus rolling)
jingle 9: a bomb is put down, a coconut or Pokey segment bounces, the map cursor cannot move
jingle 10: a menu cursor or a dialog choice moves
jingle 11: a heavy boss lands or charges (Slime Eye, Armos Knight, Moblin King)
jingle 14: something splashes into water (Link, fish, a Zora, the mermaid)
